title: Speaking — Watching films
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on watching films.

questions: What do you usually do on a Saturday morning?
Do you prefer busy or quiet weekends?
Who do you typically see at weekends?
What will you probably do next weekend?
Where do you normally watch films?
Do you often talk about a film after seeing it?

part2.topic: Describe a film scene that stayed with you.
points: how you reacted when you saw it
part2.closing: and explain why you think it was effective.

questions: What do cinemas offer that watching at home cannot easily reproduce?
How can films influence attitudes about unfamiliar places?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to watching films?
